goals: Address gaps in the architectural/building-block options available in the modpack.
scope: Provide the Stone Parapet and Stone Louvered Shutter as two AMC blocks with matching items for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric.

Use the Macaw masonry block classes and model parents. Bind the parapet directly to vanilla Stone and generate the shutter sprite locally from the andesite shutter artwork using BBB's luminance-ranked remapping and the vanilla Stone palette.

exclusions: Other materials and architectural forms, provider replacement, and IBF family integration are outside AMC C6.
Provider-derived resources and the release JAR remain in ignored local output. C1–C5 are historical provenance.

dependencies.reason: Target game and source of the Stone sprite and palette.
Loads the AMC and Macaw entrypoints on Fabric.
Supplies the Parapet and Shutter implementations, model parents, tags and shutter sound. The controlled build used Macaw's Windows 2.4.2 for 26.2 Fabric.

state.milestone: C6 introduces two Stone forms. Packaged resource checks and three controlled Fabric GameTests passed. Owner testing of the exact retained artifact is pending.

current.summary: Adds a Stone Parapet with flower-pot support and a Stone Louvered Shutter with the Macaw slat artwork recolored to vanilla Stone.
